full_judgment: 6. Leave was granted to consider the submissions made on behalf of the appellants that the order of remand is improper in that concurrent findings of the trial court and the lower appellate court are based on evidence and that the onus to prove the benami purchase to the extent of 8 annas share of the suit land is upon the defendant and that presumption in favour of nadabipatra Ext.C has been rebutted by the plaintiffs and therefore there was no room of the High Court Division to send the suit on remand.
